title: Arquiteto de domínio redes
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços TI do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira! Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.
Sobre o Papel:
Procuramos Arquiteto de domínio Redes , que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.
Principais Responsabilidades:
Liderar o projeto, a documentação e a evolução de arquiteturas de rede corporativas, industriais e de missão crítica para operações globais, subterrâneas, remotas, móveis/Io T e em nuvem/híbridas.
Especifique padrões, diagramas de alta e baixa complexidade (visão lógica, física, topologia, VLAN, roteamento, SDN), considerando redundância, disponibilidade, desempenho e resiliência.
Avaliar, selecionar e supervisionar a implantação de tecnologias emergentes: SD-WAN, SDN, Zero Trust, 5 G privado, redes mesh, VPNs, segmentação de redes OT/TI em um ambiente de mineração.
Defina e garanta a conformidade com os padrões globais de segurança (ISO 27001, NIST, LGPD, PIPEDA), políticas de criptografia, controle de acesso, mitigação de vulnerabilidades e resposta a incidentes.
Liderar projetos de integração de rede entre Brasil, Canadá, áreas industriais/minas, escritórios, plantas e data centers, possibilitando alta conectividade, performance e segurança.
Orquestrar processos de atualização tecnológica, substituição de equipamentos, automação de configuração e monitoramento de rede, incluindo SRE, Service Mesh.
Crie e mantenha documentação detalhada: diagramas, fluxos, planos de contingência, manuais, políticas de uso, governança e modelos técnicos.
Interface direta com equipes de Engenharia, Operações, Segurança, Dev Ops, Automação Industrial, equipes globais de arquitetura e fornecedores estratégicos.
Monitorar, otimizar e evoluir a infraestrutura de comunicação, visando a máxima eficiência, suporte a Io T, análise industrial, operação autônoma de mina e compliance. Competências Técnicas:
Domínio dos principais protocolos, arquiteturas e padrões: TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF/EIGRP, IPv6, DNS/DHCP, VLAN/VRF, MPLS, Wi-Fi, SD-WAN, 5 G/Edge, SASE, Zero Trust, Convergência OT/IT.
Experiência real com soluções industriais Cisco (Switching, Routing, SD-WAN, SDA), Juniper, Arista, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Rockwell/Siemens, plataformas de rede em nuvem (Azure, AWS, GCP).
Interface prática com ambientes complexos: subterrâneo/mineração, redes industriais, ambientes industriais 4.0, integração em nuvem, alta disponibilidade, recuperação de desastres.
Experiência em automação de redes (Ansible, Terraform, Python, scripts), monitoramento avançado (SNMP, Net Flow, SRE Observability).
Excelência em documentação, desenho técnico, suporte à governança, integração multiplataforma e atuação internacional com equipes remotas. Diferenciais:
Certificações: CCNP/CCIE, AWS/Azure/GCP Advanced Networking, CISSP, VMware NSX, ITIL Expert, TOGAF.
Experiência em projetos greenfield/brownfield, integração de redes industriais/Io T, edge/mesh/satélite, digitalização de minas.
Experiência com redes subterrâneas, soluções sem fio específicas para mineração, ambientes industriais de OT/TI, SRE/observabilidade em escala global.
Capacidade de trabalhar em diferentes fusos horários, ambientes multi-site e equipes multiculturais.
Inglês fluente para comunicação global. Formação: Bacharel em Engenharia Elétrica, Automação, Computação, Sistemas Industriais ou áreas afins Graduação em Sistemas ou áreas afins.
O que você pode esperar de nós?

title: Especialista de inteligÊncia operacional
description:
Descrição da vaga Somos o grupo educacional mais diversificado do país. Todos os dias, criamos futuros incríveis através da inovação. Colocamos a mão na massa para tirar as ideias do papel e colocá-las em prática. Enfrentamos desafios com resiliência e nos adaptamos às mudanças constantes.
Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #Jeito Cogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.
Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.
Responsabilidades e atribuições: • Desenvolver análises e estudos que apoiem lideranças na tomada de decisão estratégica.
• Monitorar indicadores-chave de performance (KPIs), rentabilidade, custos e produtividade, identificando desvios e oportunidades de melhoria.
• Consolidar informações de múltiplas áreas, gerando insights que impulsionam eficiência e resultados.
• Participar de projetos transversais, estruturando análises e garantindo entregas ágeis e de alto impacto.
• Apoiar a definição de padrões de performance e benchmarks entre unidades.
• Antecipar riscos operacionais, elaborando alertas preventivos e planos de ação.
Requisitos e qualificações: • Forte capacidade analítica e pensamento crítico.
• Habilidade em interpretar grandes volumes de dados e transformar em informações estratégicas.
• Boa comunicação e capacidade de traduzir análises em materiais visuais e objetivos.
• Perfil colaborativo e visão de negócio.
Diferenciais valorizados
• Experiência prévia com inteligência operacional, performance de negócios ou controladoria.
• Domínio de ferramentas de análise de dados (Excel avançado, Power BI, SQL, etc.).
• Vivência em empresas com múltiplas unidades ou estruturas descentralizadas.

Temos alguns escritórios espalhados pelo Brasil, mas você ficará alocado em São Paulo (Av. Paulista).

description:
Faça parte de uma das maiores empresas de serviços de TI do mundo! Aqui você transforma a sua carreira!
Por que entrar na TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, é por isso que vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado, cheia de oportunidades de melhoria, e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para o nosso sucesso em um ambiente colaborativo.
Estamos procurando por Especialista em Catalogo de Dados , que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira, em modalidade CLT , híbrida / presencial, na cidade de Londrina - PR .
Nessa posição você irá:
O papel do Especialista em Catálogo de Dados é fundamental para a estratégia de governança de dados da corporação. Este profissional será responsável por projetar, implementar e sustentar o catálogo de dados, garantindo que os ativos de informação sejam compreensíveis, confiáveis, acessíveis e seguros. A missão é alinhar a gestão de dados com os objetivos de negócio, capacitando as equipes de Analytics e Inteligência Artificial com dados de alta qualidade e promovendo uma cultura data-driven em toda a organização.
PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES
● Arquitetura e Implementação: Liderar e executar projetos de implementação, evolução e sustentação da plataforma de Catálogo de Dados.
● Glossário de Negócios: Definir, gerenciar e disseminar o Glossário de Termos de Negócio, assegurando a consistência semântica e o entendimento comum dos dados em toda a empresa.
● Linhagem de Dados: Desenvolver, manter e visualizar a linhagem de dados de ponta a ponta, proporcionando total transparência sobre a origem, transformações e consumo dos dados.
● Governança e Qualidade: Implementar processos de Classificação de Dados para identificar informações sensíveis (em conformidade com a LGPD) e estabelecer métricas de observabilidade e qualidade para monitorar a saúde dos ativos de dados.
● Gestão de Acesso: Definir e gerenciar as políticas de acesso aos dados catalogados, garantindo que as permissões estejam alinhadas com as diretrizes de segurança da informação.
● Liderança Técnica: Atuar como referência técnica em Governança de Dados, orientando equipes de desenvolvimento e de negócio na utilização correta do catálogo e na aplicação das melhores práticas.
Formação e Experiência Mínima
Formação superior completa e comprovada em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
Pós-graduação, MBA ou Mestrado completo em áreas como Governança de Dados, Big Data, Arquitetura de Dados ou correlatas.
Experiência mínima de 9 anos no mercado, com atuação estratégica e liderança técnica em projetos de Governança de Dados.
Estabilidade profissional exemplar, com uma média de 3 anos nas últimas posições em seu histórico.
Inglês avançado ou fluente. Certificações desejáveis
Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
Informatica Certified Professional Competências Técnicas (Hard Skills) Mandatório: Experiência sólida e comprovável em projetos de Catálogo de Dados utilizando a suíte INFORMATICA ou uma das seguintes ferramentas de Governança de Dados: Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Ataccama, SAP Enterprise Master Data Governance, SAS ou Talend. A experiência deve abranger: Implementação de Glossário de Termos.
Mapeamento de Linhagem de Dados.
Processos de Classificação de Dados.
Monitoramento de Qualidade e Observabilidade de Dados.

Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, SQL Server) e No SQL, tanto on-premise quanto em nuvem. Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills)
Resolução de Problemas: Perfil analítico, engajado e proativo na solução de desafios complexos.

title: Operations manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.
Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.
Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.
Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to): Operational Leadership
Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development.
Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required. Team Development
Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training. Compliance & QHSE
Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements. Commercial
Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents,

title: Senior data engineer
description:
About Eightpoint
Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U. S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.
About the Role
We are seeking a Full-Stack Data Engineer to join our Mobile Applications department. This is a hybrid role that combines data engineering with data science overlap, giving you full ownership of the data lifecycle — from ingestion to transformation, analysis, and storytelling.
You will build and optimize scalable pipelines, ingest mobile app data from diverse sources, ensure infrastructure reliability, and deliver insights that directly influence how our apps grow. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics, equally capable of writing production-grade pipelines and uncovering meaningful trends in user behavior.
Key Responsibilities
Data Infrastructure & Pipelines
Build and maintain scalable, end-to-end pipelines across cloud environments. Ingest and transform data from files, APIs, mobile telemetry (Firebase, Amplitude, Google Analytics), and external databases into centralized stores.
Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
Implement data quality monitoring, governance policies, and best practices for privacy, security, and compliance.
Participate in technical architecture discussions, contributing expertise on scalable, efficient data systems. Analytics & Insights
Conduct exploratory and advanced analysis using SQL, Python, and statistical methods.
Collaborate with Analysts, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Support experimentation and A/B testing by ensuring clean, reliable datasets and analyzing results.
Deliver actionable recommendations that influence mobile product strategy, user acquisition, and retention. Collaboration & Best Practices
Engage in peer code reviews to uphold high standards of quality and maintainability.
Work cross-functionally with software engineering and business teams to ensure data solutions align with company priorities.
Document pipelines, workflows, and methodologies to foster reusability and knowledge sharing. Who You Are
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role focused on data infrastructure and pipelines.
Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency in Python (or a similar programming language such as Java or C#).
Experience with AWS (Redshift, RDS, S3) and Google Cloud (Big Query, Firebase) for managing cloud-based databases and analytics tools.
Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, or similar).
Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ELT/ETL best practices, and dimensional modeling. Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git Hub).
Excellent communicator who can bridge technical depth with clear storytelling for non-technical stakeholders.

We’re looking for an experienced QA Engineer who ramps up quickly on complex business domains and turns that understanding into clear, risk-based test strategies. Isso gera um perfil que normalmente é:
Conforme (C) – Característica principal Extremamente organizada Segue processos e padrões
Atenta a detalhes

Preocupada com qualidade e precisão Dominante (D) – Característica secundária Decidida e assertiva Focada em resultados
Não tem medo de assumir responsabilidades
Capaz de tomar decisões rápidas

title: Analista de dados sênior
description:
ALLOSé uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre aAliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.Atividades:Coletar e limpar dados, identificando fontes relevantes e tratando valores ausentes e outliers;

Desenvolver dashboards, queries, algorítmos para monitorar e melhorar a performance dos processos;

Traduzir problemas de negócios em termos analíticos e facilitar tomadas de decisão para resolução destes problemas;
Propor pró-ativamente soluções técnicas e de negócio;
Ser pró-ativo na garantia de segurança e privacidade dos dados, cumprindo regulamentações.Requisitos:
Formação em tecnologia, ciências exatas/biológicas com foco em tecnologia ou experiência comprovada na área de banco de dados;
Experiência em Data Analytics, Big Query/Databricks;
Conhecimento Avançado em análise de dados e estatística intermediário (Amostragem, Teste de Hipótese, Inferência).
SQL (DQL, DDL) Avançado.;
Conhecimento Intermediário linguagens como Java Script, Python ou R. Experiencia em extração de dados, ingestão e transformação;
Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Tableau, Power BI).Nossos benefícios:Vale Refeição/Alimentação;

Implementação e Treinamento
● Coordenar a implementação de novos Vendors, garantindo uma transição fluida desde a assinatura do contrato até a ativação no Marketplace.

● Experiência prévia em Customer Success, preferencialmente no setor de turismo ou áreas relacionadas.
● Idiomas: Espanhol e Português. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita.
● Capacidade de entender as necessidades específicas dos Operadores Turísticos e desenvolver soluções personalizadas.
● Disponibilidade para viagens ocasionais, conforme a necessidade do cliente.
● Perfil orientado a resultados, com histórico de garantir o sucesso dos clientes.
● Conhecimento básico de plataformas CRM e ferramentas de atendimento ao cliente.
.Oferecemos
● Salário competitivo.
● Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, inovador e colaborativo.
● Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.

title: Analista júnior de antifraude e experiência do cliente
description:
No dia a dia, a equipe deCustomer Experienceacompanha de perto o cliente, entendendo seu contexto, prioridades e garantindo que as soluções de antifraude da Topaz funcionem de forma consistente.Trata-se de uma atuação em ambientes de alta criticidade, muitas vezes dentro de instituições financeiras, onde estabilidade, segurança e precisão são fundamentais para a operação.
A equipe representa a Topaz diretamente no cliente, atuando com responsabilidade técnica, análise e suporte às operações. Atender e acompanhar os chamados do cliente, garantindo agilidade e clareza na resolução.
Realizar análises de vulnerabilidades e resposta a incidentes, via tickets ou reuniões.

Atuar tecnicamente na sustentação das soluções de segurança implementadas.
Prever e padronizar procedimentos de recuperação de dados e respostas a tentativas de invasão.
Realizar testes de falhas e respostas.
Conduzir levantamentos contínuos e diagnósticos para prevenção de riscos.
Atender o cliente na instalação, operação e atualização dos softwares e plataformas de proteção virtual da Topaz.O que você precisa conhecer para ser parte da Topaz?
Fundamental: Conhecimentos de sistemas operacionais (Desktop e Mobile), lógica de programação e Redes de computadores.
Experiência prévia em ambientes de alta criticidade, com participação em situações de incidentes ou salas de crises.
Capacidade de realizar consultas básicas em bancos de dados.

title: Social media specialist
description:
About the Product:For more than 30 years,Carnegiehas been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimisation, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.Job Purpose:
Social Media Specialists are responsible for managing paid social media advertising campaigns, including account and campaign setup, audience creation, bidding and budget management, and regular testing for Carnegie’s higher education clients. They also lead organic social media initiatives, including audits, content strategy, and social listening, to help clients build an integrated and effective social presence.Duties and Responsibilities:
Paid Social Media Campaign Management
Launch paid social media campaigns across all major social platforms (Meta, Linked In, Snapchat, Tik Tok, Reddit) per the latest best practices
Maintain and monitor campaign performance, analysing conversion rate, cost per conversion, cost per click, impression share, and other important campaign metrics
Strategically optimise social media campaigns regularly for optimal performance
Organic Social Media Services
Lead Organic Social Media Audits, including performance analysis, content review, and actionable recommendations for client growth
Develop Organic Content Strategy deliverables, such as monthly content calendars and insights decks, to support institutional goals
Guide Social Listening projects, analysing conversations, sentiment, and brand mentions to inform client strategy and reputation management
Partner with clients to align organic strategies with paid media efforts, creating integrated social approaches
Reporting and Analysis
Analyse campaign performance effectively based on data trends seen in the platform and Looker Studio dashboards to create client-facing insights
Proactively craft meaningful recommendations for client review based on campaign data trends that will have a positive impact on performance
Internal Teamwork
Collaborate across the social team to ensure cohesive support for both paid and organic service lines
Keep pace with paid and organic social media industry trends, sharing articles and updates from platform representatives with the team
Participate in content creation such as social media blogs, webinars, and internal and external resourcesKnowledge, Skills & Abilities:
Expertise in both paid and organic social media management
Excellent attention to detail
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt to new technologies
Demonstrated ability to work as part of a team while simultaneously managing an independent workload/tasks
Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new and changing technologies
Passion, energy, and enthusiasm for digital marketing and customer service/client success
Due to the remote environment, effective communication and time management skills are required, as well as the ability to use/learn multiple technology platforms and switch between them on a regular basisCredentials and Experience:
2+ years of experience working in paid and organic social media
Experience managing paid campaigns within Facebook Ads Manager, Linked In Campaign Manager, Snapchat Business Manager, Reddit Ads Manager, and/or Tik Tok Ads
Experience with organic social media management, including audits, content strategy, and performance reporting
Bachelor’s degree required; Marketing/Advertising major or concentration preferred
Data analysis experience, particularly experience analysing digital campaign metrics to measure success
Familiarity with Asana or other project management tools is a plusWe offer:
We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and a flexible work schedule.
Personal laptop.
Health/Sport Budget.
Fully remote.

title: Especialista em tráfego
description:
Resumo do cargoA pessoa Especialista de Performance Marketing será responsável por planejar, executar e otimizar campanhas pagas em Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook e Instagram), Tik Tok Ads e Kwai – sempre orientada por dados e focada em ROI. Você vai atuar lado a lado com nosso time de Conteúdo, Design e Data Analytics para atrair tráfego qualificado, gerar conversões e impulsionar nossa receita.Principalmente Meta Ads. Como ter sucesso nesse cargo
Dominar métricas: saber interpretar CAC, LTV, ROAS, CTR, CPM, CPI e funil completo, tomando decisões diárias baseadas nesses indicadores.
Mentalidade de teste contínuo: criar hipóteses, rodar A/B/n tests, documentar aprendizados e escalar rapidamente o que funciona.
Visão holística de tracking: garantir que tags, UTMs, pixels e eventos GA4/Server-Side estejam 100 % corretos para medir cada etapa da jornada.
Colaboração radical: comunicar-se de forma clara com equipes criativas e de tecnologia, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em briefs, relatórios e next steps.
Atualização constante: acompanhar mudanças de algoritmo, políticas de anúncios e novas features nas plataformas para manter vantagem competitiva.
Como o cargo se encaixa na organização
Motor de crescimento: suas campanhas representam o principal canal de aquisição de usuários e receita, sustentando metas de vendas e expansão internacional.
Parceiro de produto: os insights de audiência e criativo alimentam a roadmap de produto, ajudando a priorizar features que trazem maior valor para o cliente.
Guardião de dados: garantindo tracking e relatórios, você sustenta decisões estratégicas para C-level e investidoras/es.
Responsabilidades
Desenvolver e executar estratégias multicanais em Google Ads (Search, Display, Performance Max), Meta Ads, Tik Tok Ads e Kwai, alinhadas às metas de negócio.
Gerenciar orçamentos diários, semanais e mensais, otimizando lances, segmentações e criativos para maximizar ROAS.
Implementar e validar tags/pixels via Google Tag Manager, GA4, CAPI (Meta) e plataforma server-side, assegurando conformidade com LGPD/GDPR.
Criar dashboards em Looker Studio ou Power BI que traduzam métricas complexas em insights acionáveis para equipes internas.
Liderar rituais de experimentação, documentar hipóteses e resultados, e apresentar recomendações de escala ou descontinuidade de campanhas.
Colaborar com Design & Conteúdo para briefing, feedback e iteração de criativos estáticos, vídeos UGC e copies persuasivas.
Monitorar concorrência e tendências do mercado, identificando novas oportunidades de canais, formatos e audiências.
Treinar e orientar outras pessoas do time (estagiárias/os ou analistas) em melhores práticas de performance e tracking.
Qualificações essenciais
Experiência: 1 + ano gerenciando campanhas de performance em pelo menos dois dos canais principais (Google, Meta, Tik Tok, Kwai) com budgets relevantes.
Competências técnicas
Configuração e otimização de campanhas (Search, Display, Video, App, Shopping, Advantage+).
Construção de funis full-funnel, remarketing dinâmico e segmentações lookalike.
Leitura avançada de métricas no GA4, Big Query e planilhas/análises ad hoc.
Implementação de UTMs, pixels, GTM, Google Consent Mode, CAPI e event-mapping server-side.
Competências analíticas: Excel ou Google Sheets avançado, pensamento crítico orientado a ROI.
Competências de comunicação: escrita clara, storytelling com dados e apresentação de resultados a stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
Certificações desejáveis (não eliminatórias):
Google Ads Search/Display/Video/App Professional
Meta Certified Media Buying Professional
Tik Tok Ads Certification (Tik Tok Academy)
Certificação GA4 ou Tag Manager; fundamentos de Server-Side Tracking (GTM SS, Stape, Rudder Stack).

title: Solution architect
description:

Vivência com metodologias de desenvolvimento Waterfall e Agile.

title: Especialista de controladoria
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.Responsabilidades e atribuiçõesBuscamos uma pessoa para atuar na controladoria societária com foco em normas contábeis nacionais e internacionais, assegurando a correta consolidação das demonstrações financeiras, conformidade regulatória e suporte técnico às auditorias externas e internas.Garantir a correta aplicação das normas contábeis (CPC/IFRS) nas demonstrações financeiras consolidadas;
Elaborar, revisar e validar balanços patrimoniais, DRE, DFC e notas explicativas;
Realizar consolidação contábil de empresas do grupo, incluindo transações intercompany e ajustes de equivalência patrimonial;
Apoiar processos de reestruturação societária, fusões, cisões e incorporações;
Atuar como ponto focal técnico junto às auditorias externas e internas, fornecendo suporte e documentação;
Realizar análises críticas de contas contábeis, conciliações e validações de saldos;
Participar de projetos de melhoria de processos contábeis, automação e compliance;
Interagir com áreas como jurídico, fiscal, planejamento e tesouraria para alinhamento de informações societárias;
Monitorar atualizações regulatórias e propor ajustes nos processos contábeis conforme necessário.Requisitos e qualificaçõesFormação completa em Ciências Contábeis com CRC ativo;
Especialização (desejável): Pós-graduação ou MBA em Controladoria, Contabilidade ou Finanças;
Experiência sólida em controladoria societária, consolidação contábil e elaboração de demonstrações financeiras;
Experiência em empresas de auditoria (Big4) será considerado um diferencial;
Conhecimento avançado em normas contábeis brasileiras (CPC) e internacionais (IFRS);
Domínio de Excel avançado, ERP (SAP) e ferramentas de BI (Power BI).Informações adicionaisO Que Temos Para VocêVale Refeição/Alimentação;

title: Project manager (email marketing agency)
description:
Flowiumis a full-service email marketing agency for e Commerce brands and their owners. Our mission is to deliver result-driven email marketing solutions while applying our core values in every experience that our clients, customers, and team members have with our team. Email Marketing is our passion, and we remain dedicated and committed to being leaders within the industry.

You should be someone who loves testing and using data to develop your strategy.Fluent in English with Excellent Communication Skills
Since you will have weekly calls with American clients, you should be fluent in English. Strong interpersonal and communication skills are also crucial.Time Management
You’ll be expected to manage your work schedule and the schedules of team members operating across many different time zones. Working early in EST hours may be required.
You’ll need terrific time management skills to hit deadlines and deliver excellent results.Communication Skills
Email Marketing - Project Managers are great notetakers and comfortable conversationalists that intuitively understand how to best communicate with clients. Whether you’re writing a quick email or hopping on an hour-long call, you should be able to get your point across quickly and clearly.Marketing or Sales Experience
Our Email Marketing - Project Managers are the face of Flowium, and we want our clients to know they are in good hands. Experience with working in a sales or marketing environment is important when not only dealing with an array of people but the implementation of new ideas as well.QualitiesPassion for marketing and implementing data-driven strategies
An independent worker who is responsible for their tasks
A team player who enjoys working with a team of diverse backgrounds
A stickler for deadlines who wants the occasional curveball
A leader who is proactive and willing to take the initiative
A detail fanatic who can spot an email typo at first glance
A notetaker who enjoys making and using to-do listsEmail Strategy & Implementation- 20%
Project Management - 50%
Client Meetings - 20%
Reports / Admin - 10%What We OfferRemote Opportunity
You will join a global team that is 100% location independent and exclusively uses remote collaboration. As a self-motivated and responsible individual, you will be free to work from any location.Open Time Off Policy
We want our team members to maintain a flexible and healthy lifestyle with an overall work-life balance.We support team members in managing their own time, including Paid Time Off. We’re proud to offer an Open Paid Time Off Policy where time off is not micromanaged or limited. We trust and respect our team members in their commitment to the overall success of Flowium.Cutting Edge Technology
We use the best tools available to make your process as smooth and as comfortable as possible. These include Asana, Slack, Loom, Miro, and Klaviyo. If you’re not familiar with a tool we rely on, don’t worry -- we’ll make you an expert.Develop Your Skills

title: Senior data scientist / ml engineer

Oversee the utilization of advanced machine learning techniques, including predictive modeling, recommendation systems, and natural language processing.

Develop and maintain robust, scalable data pipelines to support all phases of the ML lifecycle.

Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
Collaboration and Communication
Serve as the primary technical conduit among executive business leads, product management, and data/engineering teams.
Facilitate demos, strategic reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation.
Drive the adoption of new data science capabilities and gather feedback for continuous strategic alignment.
Release and Change Management
Coordinate comprehensive release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for ML model and data product deployments.
Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered effectively.
Track and report on post-release issues, adoption metrics, and stabilization progress.Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:
Proven ability to set technical direction, produce high-quality work, manage autonomously, and take strategic initiative.
Strong business acumen with unwavering ethics and a willingness to lead by example.
Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and in executive roles.
Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements at a strategic level.
Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.Requirements:
Minimum of 10 years of experiencein machine learning engineering, data science, or a related analytical/leadership role within Saa S, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.
Demonstrated experience in managing and mentoring a teamof data scientists or ML engineers.
Expert-level experience building and deploying segmentation and propensity modelsin a commercial setting.
Familiarity with machine learning frameworks and libraries (e.g., Tensor Flow, Py Torch, scikit-learn).
Experience with data manipulation and analysis using Python (e.g., Pandas, Num Py).
Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Big Query, Redshift, GCS, S3).
Proficiency in SQL for complex data querying and manipulation.
Experience with Git and Git providers (e.g., Git Hub, Bit Bucket, Git Lab).
Deep understanding of statistical analysis, experimental design, and A/B testing methodologies.Nice-to-haves:
Experience with media modeling audiences and digital lookalike techniques.
Experience with natural language processing (NLP) techniques and tools.
Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Matplotlib, Seaborn).
Knowledge of educational technology or career development domains.Credentials and Experience:
Ph Din Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

Personal laptop.

Fully remote.

description:

Competência para realizar pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas em UX Research, incluindo entrevistas, análise de logs de conversação e pesquisas de satisfação.
Experiência em ambientes ágeis, com atuação em squads (Scrum/Kanban) e colaboração direta com Product Owners (PO) e equipes de engenharia.- O que temos pra te oferecer?Mais do que um plano de carreira!A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. title: Devops engineer - work from home - talent connection
description:

Join our close-knit LATAM remote team: Connect through fun activities like coffee breaks, tech talks, and games with your team-mates and management.Say goodbye to micromanagement!We champion autonomy, open communication, and respect for diversity as our core values.⚖️Your well-being matters: Our People Care team is here from day one to support you with everything from time-off requests to wellness check-ins.Plus, our Accounts Management team ensures smooth, effective client relationships, so you can focus on what you do best.Ready to grow with us?Here’s what we offer you by joining us!Competitive USD salary– We value your skills and contributions!

Birthday day off– Enjoy an extra day off during your birthday week to celebrate in style with friends and family!About the project:At Nearsure, we know great talent doesn’t wait for job openings. That’s why we’re building a community of passionate professionals for future opportunities.These proactive searches align with the profiles our trusted clients seek regularly. Join our "Future Talent" network to be among the first considered when the right opportunity arises.With over 160 new hires every year, we are constantly expanding our team with passionate and skilled professionals who want to make an impact.As aDev Ops Engineer, you will be fundamental in the management, automation, and monitoring of our hosting infrastructure, ensuring high availability and scalability across multiple cloud providers and on-premise environments.How your day-to-day work will look like:✅ Contribute to the administration and operation of our cloud-hosted environments (AWS and GCP, with future potential for Azure) and across virtual and bare-metal installations.
✅ Lead infrastructure management using Terraform to ensure that all environments are provisioned, maintained, and scaled efficiently and with a high degree of automation.
✅ Administer and optimize Kubernetes clusters, guaranteeing smooth and reliable deployment and operation.
✅ Design, maintain, and improve our Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, with demonstrable experience in Git Lab CI/CD.
✅ Responsible for the configuration, maintenance, and use of observability stacks such as Grafana, Loki, and Prometheus (or Open Telemetry).
✅ Build and maintain robust health monitoring dashboards and smart alerting systems, implementing a monitoring model per tenant for aggregation into a centralized view.This would make you the ideal candidate:✨ Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
✨ +5 Years of experience working in a Dev Ops, SRE, or Platform Engineer role.
✨ Advanced proficiency in Terraform for cloud infrastructure management.
✨ Strong experience managing infrastructure and services in at least one major cloud provider (AWS or GCP), and exposure to Multi-Cloud or on-premise environments.
✨ Solid experience in Kubernetes administration.
✨ Strong knowledge of CI/CD processes and tools, preferably Git Lab.
✨ Hands-on experience implementing and administering the Grafana, Loki, and Prometheus stacks (or similar alerting and telemetry solutions).
✨ Advanced English Level is required for this role as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.What to expect from our Talent Connection process:Sign up:Apply to this position and upload your resume.
Profile review:Our team will review your profile and keep it in our talent database.
Contact:Our team will contact you to have an interview to get to know you better and to share with you a bit more of what we are looking for.
Knowing you better:We'd love to discuss your experience in an interview with our recruiters.
Notification:When a suitable position opens, we’ll contact you to start the selection process, having in mind that this process will be faster because we already had the first screening.
Transparency:This process is direct and without intermediaries.At Nearsure, we’re dedicated to solving complex business challenges through cutting-edge technology and we believe in the power of tailored solutions. Whether you are passionate about transforming businesses with Generative AI, building innovative software products, or implementing comprehensive enterprise platform solutions, we invite you to be part of our dynamic team!We would love to hear from you if you are eager to make an impact and join a collaborative team that values creativity and expertise.Let’s work together to shape the future of technology!

title: Digital strategy director
description:

The Director of Digital Strategy is responsible for contributing to the leadership, management, and overall success of the Digital Strategy team. This role oversees strategy and reporting for 5–7 clients, leading the planning and strategic execution of paid search, display, streaming, and paid social campaigns that are measurable, effective, and aligned with each client’s goals. The Director serves as a team leader, bringing innovative and thoughtful approaches to client success, reporting, and paid media strategy.Duties and Responsibilities
Strategic Campaign Oversight
Maintain strategic oversight of 5–7 complex, holistic client accounts, owning the development, implementation, and optimization of digital strategy and paid media budgets across all channels, typically with annual budgets of $500k+.
Architect comprehensive digital strategies driven by clients’ marketing goals and objectives.
Oversee and verify that ongoing account maintenance and optimization activities align with campaign goals across all channels.
Client Interaction
Foster strong client–agency relationships through recurring strategy calls, acting as an expert partner who advises on best practices and strategic direction.
Play a supervisory role by overseeing Digital Strategists’ work on key clients, including participation in client calls.
Reporting and Analysis
Conduct research, analyze performance data, and translate findings into actionable insights and strategic recommendations—including budget adjustments and optimization strategies.
Provide in-depth monthly and ad-hoc reporting using tools such as Google Analytics, Looker Studio, custom ROI dashboards, and platform reporting interfaces.
Ensure that all reporting clearly communicates campaign goals and effectively articulates key takeaways, recommendations, and next steps.
Continually evaluate the effectiveness and client experience of reporting and analysis to ensure they meet evolving client needs.
Team Management and Supervisory Responsibilities
Support leadership of the Digital Strategy team, with potential responsibility for directly managing 2-3 team members.
Lead onboarding, training, and ongoing mentoring of direct reports, and contribute to the professional growth of team members across the department.
Internal Team Responsibilities
Collaborate with client account teams to manage relationships and ensure client success.
Partner with the sales team to strengthen and expand relationships with existing clients and support digital strategy development for prospective clients.
Promote cross-divisional communication and collaboration to ensure a seamless internal workflow and client experience.
Stay current on digital marketing trends, emerging platforms, and industry developments.
Demonstrate thought leadership through contributions to team meetings, process improvements, and opportunities for service expansion.
Contribute to the Carnegie blog, webinars, workshops, and conference presentations, as appropriate.Knowledge, Skills & Abilities
Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment.
Strong verbal and written communication skills; able to confidently present campaign performance to clients and internal teams.
Proven problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently, use available resources effectively, and escalate issues when appropriate.
Effective communication and time management skills, particularly in a remote environment; ability to learn and switch between multiple technology platforms.
Physical requirement: Must be able to work at a computer for prolonged periodsCredentials and Experience
Bachelor’s degree required; Marketing/Advertising major or concentration preferred
5–7 years of experience with paid digital platforms, media planning, and/or execution of digital marketing campaigns
Expertise in analyzing and reporting on data trends with a full understanding of digital marketing KPIs and success metrics
Experience using and analyzing data visualization tools such as Google Looker Studio and Google Analytics
Expertise and direct experience with Google Ads, Facebook Ads Manager, Linked In Campaign Manager, and Google Display & Video 360, or other DSP required
Google Ads and/or Google Analytics certifications a plus
Experience with Asana or other project management software tools a plus
Agency experience is a plusWe offer
We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), and a flexible work schedule.
Personal laptop.

Fully remote.

title: Senior manager, shared services center
description:
About the company:COFCO International is a global agribusiness company that purchases, stores, sells, processes, and distributes essential agricultural commodities: grains, oilseeds, sugar, cotton, and coffee.
Headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, COFCO International employs approximately 11,000 professionals in 37 countries and has assets on every continent, with operations in more than 50 countries.
COFCO International is an agribusiness platform of COFCO Corporation, one of China's largest agricultural and food companies, with global operations.About the position:
Responsible for COFCO's transactional processes in the areas of Accounting, Tax Calculation, Tax Receipts, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Service Contracts, Freight, and Consumer Account Management, ensuring process efficiency through compliance with the area's KPIs and SLAs.Main responsibilities:
Develop and implement effective strategies for the SSC, aligned with the objectives of each business;
Identify and implement continuous improvements in SSC processes and systems, with the aim of increasing efficiency and reducing costs;
Collaborate with other functional areas and business leaders to ensure efficient service delivery;
Manage the calculation of federal, state, and municipal taxes, with the aim of collecting debts and/or refunding tax benefits in accordance with current legislation. Ensure compliance with ancillary obligations within the established deadlines;
Ensure the control of service contracts, leases, and similar agreements, from the receipt of the supply process to the termination of the contract;
Manage COFCO's financial control involving Accounts Payable and Receivable operations, ensuring write-offs and controls and advances made to suppliers, following established policies;
Responsible for ensuring all COFCO Freight and Transit operations, from contracting services to accurate entries and payments;
Responsible for seeking efficiency in SSC operations through SLAs agreed with each business leader;
Ensure the accounting reconciliation of COFCO INTL companies in Brazil, aiming to comply with accounting standards and in line with global Controllership guidelines;
Ensure compliance with the budget and manage expenses under your management, in line with company policies and departmental objectives;
Promote continuous improvement and automation of processes under your management and implement the necessary controls to mitigate risks and losses for the company;
Responsible for complying with current laws and internal procedures and being the point of reference;
Seek to unify and standardize transaction processes for the SSC.Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related fields;
MBA/Postgraduate degree – Controllership, Financial Management, and People Management;
More than 7 years of experience in SSC is required;
Work experience in a multinational company in a matrix environment and in the agribusiness sector;
Solid knowledge of accounting, financial management, calculations, internal control, reports, and financial processes;
Fluency in English;
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, and Power Point);
Experience with the SAP system;
Experience with SLAs and KPIs;
Strong project and process management skills;
Experience with AI and automation, bringing innovative solutions to the business;
Analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on continuous improvement;
Must have a strong ability to interact effectively with different hierarchical levels;
Effective management and leadership skills with strong verbal and written communication skills;
Proven experience in leading teams in the Shared Services Center area;
Willingness to live and work in the city of São José do Rio Preto.Please send your resume in English.

title: Data Lead Engineer - Snowflake
description:
Title: Data Lead Engineer – Snowflake

Location: Remote Mexico/Brazi

Job Type: Contract

Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

• End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

• Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

• Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

• Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.

Qualifications

Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

• Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

• Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

• Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Preferred Skills:

• Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

• Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

• Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

• Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

title: Talent Manager
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Talent Manager to manage the end-to-end recruitment delivery for customer-side non-technical roles at Turing. You will be responsible for facilitating sourcing candidates, talent planning, capacity management, and internal supply optimization, while activating external sourcing channels where necessary. The ideal candidate has experience in client hiring setups, is highly organized, thrives in dynamic environments, and excels at stakeholder management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the single point of contact between the Internal Delivery and Talent Fulfilment teams for assigned projects.
  • Manage end-to-end fulfilment for multiple client requirements concurrently (typically 3–4 at a time).
  • Conduct talent pool assessments and identify supply-demand gaps.
  • Activate external sourcing channels (via partnerships or talent acquisition teams) when internal supply is insufficient.
  • Oversee resource planning and capacity management, ensuring timely ramp-ups for customer-side roles.
  • Collaborate with Delivery Leads to understand project requirements and talent expectations.
  • Ensure data accuracy and visibility across systems — maintaining reports on hiring pipelines, fulfilment progress, and performance metrics.
  • Track and report fulfilment metrics, including fill rates, turnaround times, and candidate quality.
  • Partner with recruiting and sourcing teams to improve process efficiency and hiring velocity.
  • Deliver a strong stakeholder experience, maintaining proactive communication and alignment on timelines and expectations.
  • Continuously look for opportunities to improve internal talent fulfilment processes and introduce best practices.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 7–12 years of experience in talent operations, recruitment delivery, or resource planning within IT services, outsourcing, or global staffing environments.
  • Proven experience in client-side hiring setups and resource & capacity management.
  • Experience handling multiple simultaneous delivery pipelines and managing cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter(good to have) and Google tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive) for tracking and reporting.
  • Data analysis and reporting skills — able to extract insights, identify trends, and drive data-backed decisions.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-paced, and evolving environment.
  • Experience working across global time zones and in cross-cultural teams.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in non-technical recruitment delivery or managing customer-side talent fulfilment.
  • Exposure to capacity planning tools or reporting dashboards.
  • Prior experience in startups or high-growth organizations with minimal structure.
  • Understanding of internal mobility, workforce planning, or project-based staffing models.

Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder communication and collaboration skills.
  • Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
  • Adaptability — thrives in ambiguity and rapidly changing environments.
  • Proactive problem solver with a focus on ownership over hierarchy.
  • Comfortable handling multiple priorities and working under tight timelines.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on operator who thrives at the intersection of talent fulfilment, data-driven decision-making, and stakeholder management. They should be proactive, outcome-oriented, and capable of maintaining operational excellence in a remote-first, high-speed environment.

title: Analista de Controladoria
description:
Somos o Grupo SADA!

Um grupo referência em transporte e logística, além de atuação em diversos segmentos de negócios movidos por milhares de pessoas dispostas a darem o seu melhor, todos os dias. Somos serviços, informação, indústria, concessionárias, energia limpa, esporte e responsabilidade social movimentando a vida das pessoas há mais de 45 anos, e é isso que nos faz ir mais longe.

Venha para uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil. Uma empresa que cuida das pessoas e se preocupa em proporcionar um ambiente de trabalho cada vez mais saudável e seguro, pois queremos que nossos colaboradores sempre sintam orgulho de trabalhar aqui.

Somos plurais por natureza, um grupo diverso em negócios e pessoas. Acreditamos que as diferenças somam e movimentam, e é por isso que o Grupo SADA quer conhecer você. Todas as nossas vagas são extensivas as Pessoas com Deficiência e profissionais reabilitados do INSS. Quem sabe alguma oportunidade combina com você.

Analista de Controladoria Pleno

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Controladoria para fortalecer nossa área e contribuir diretamente com a governança, confiabilidade das informações financeiras e melhoria contínua dos processos internos do Grupo.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Revisar Demonstrações Financeiras mensais e anuais, garantindo conformidade com normas contábeis e os prazos da Diretoria;
  • Promover a adequação às normas contábeis em todas as empresas do Grupo, estruturando planos de ação e cronogramas;
  • Participar de projetos de auditoria em parceria com contabilidade e outras áreas;
  • Conduzir entrevistas para mapeamento de processos internos, desenvolvendo narrativas e/ou fluxogramas com identificação de riscos, controles e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Apoiar a criação e execução de planos de ação para correção de deficiências ou implementação de novos controles;
  • Colaborar no mapeamento e implantação de controles internos nas diversas áreas e empresas;
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de políticas internas e formalização de procedimentos.

Pré-requisitos

  • Conhecimento técnico sólido em contabilidade e processos internos;
  • Capacidade analítica para identificar melhorias e propor planos de ação;
  • Conhecimento em IFRS e BRGAAP ;
  • Experiência com auditoria interna ou externa será um diferencial;
  • Ensino superior completo em Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Administração ou áreas afins;
  • Vivência prévia em controladoria, contabilidade, finanças, fiscal ou correlatas;

NOSSA HISTÓRIA

Para contar a história do nosso grupo empresarial precisamos voltar ao Brasil dos anos 70, quando um jovem visionário desembarcava da Europa trazendo objetivos bem audaciosos. Ali, iniciava a trajetória da SADA, com a implantação de uma pequena transportadora na região metropolitana de Belo Horizonte.

Fundada em 4 de agosto de 1976, na cidade de Contagem, em Minas Gerais, a SADA Transportes e Armazéns S/A é criada, a partir da necessidade de atender as demandas de armazenagem e distribuição automobilística no país.

Sete anos depois, em 1983, a empresa é transferida para Betim em um terreno de cerca de 31 mil metros quadrados, 23 vezes menor que a área ocupada pela empresa atualmente.

“Ainda muito jovem, cheguei aqui vindo da Itália com a tarefa de montar a SADA no Brasil junto com a chegada da Fiat”, conta Vittorio Medioli, fundador presidente do Grupo SADA.

Assim como seu precursor, a origem do nome SADA também é italiana:

TRADIÇÃO EM CRESCER

Apesar das dificuldades políticas e econômicas da época, a empresa estabeleceu uma tradição em crescer, valorizando o trabalho em equipe e as habilidades individuais dos colaboradores em um ambiente onde todos se sentem orgulhosos de construir uma história de solidez e grandes conquistas.

title: Territory Manager
description:
XPEL, Inc. (NASDAQ: XPEL), a leading supplier of automotive paint protection films, window films, ceramic coatings, and commercial/residential flat glass films, is currently seeking a Territory Manager for the Southern Brazil region (Porto Alegre/Florianópolis/Curitiba)

Resumo da Vaga:

O Territory Manager será responsável pelas vendas gerais dos produtos XPEL em sua área de atuação.

Esse profissional atuará tanto com concessionárias quanto com instaladores independentes, ou em uma combinação de ambos, dependendo do potencial do mercado local.

O mercado automotivo contemplado inclui o segmento de pós-venda automotivo (aftermarket) — abrangendo instaladores de películas automotivas (window fims, PPF), studios de detalhamento automotivo, franquias e instaladores profissionais independentes — além de novas concessionárias de veículos.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Gerir e expandir as vendas no território designado, com foco em atingir ou superar as metas de crescimento.
  • Atuar de forma ativa em vendas, estando em campo cerca de 50% do tempo com clientes atuais e potenciais.
  • Manter e aprimorar a satisfação dos clientes, oferecendo um serviço excepcional e construindo relacionamentos de longo prazo.
  • Monitorar e analisar o uso dos produtos pelos clientes, identificando oportunidades para introdução de novos produtos e maximização de receita.
  • Gerenciar e desenvolver relacionamentos comerciais, fornecendo relatórios gerenciais regulares conforme necessário.
  • Ser o principal ponto de contato com os clientes, garantindo comunicação e suporte eficazes por meio de diversos canais (e-mail, telefone, apresentações online, compartilhamento de tela e reuniões presenciais).
  • Realizar análises de mercado e desenvolver estratégias de aquisição e conquista de novos clientes.
  • Fazer o follow-up de leads de vendas, colaborando com a equipe de Administração de Vendas para garantir a integração e onboarding eficiente de novos clientes.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os Gerentes de Loja e Instaladores Chefes, assegurando a perfeita coordenação entre as áreas de vendas e operações.
  • Prospectar novas oportunidades de crescimento, criando iniciativas estratégicas e ações proativas.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências e inovações do setor automotivo, participando de treinamentos internos, lendo publicações especializadas e ampliando sua rede de contatos profissionais.

Qualificações Necessárias:

  • Formação superior em Administração, Marketing ou áreas correlatas (ou experiência equivalente).
  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência profissional em vendas, com histórico comprovado de resultados.
  • Perfil proativo, altamente motivado e organizado.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, relacionamento interpessoal, análise e resolução de problemas.
  • Forte capacidade de negociação e gestão de relacionamento com clientes.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens (cerca de 50%).
  • Carteira de habilitação válida, com histórico de direção limpo.
  • Residência dentro do território designado.
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões adequadas, com foco em atendimento ao cliente, segurança e cumprimento de prazos.
  • Domínio do Pacote Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).

title: Interdisciplinary Project Teacher: English, Grades 6-8
description:
Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.

Job Description

WHY TEACH AT AVENUES?

Avenues | The World School prepares students for engaged global citizenship during a time of unprecedented complexity and accelerating change, combining language immersion, interdisciplinary learning, a global curriculum, and a culture of creativity and deep collaboration.

DEEP COLLABORATION, CONSTANT EVOLUTION

Collaboration here isn't a buzzword: it's woven into everything we do. At Avenues, no one teaches on an island. Substantial time to collaborate is embedded into the schedule. Teacher teams, across multiple disciplines, design learning experiences together. This intensity of collaboration is challenging as well as exciting: we're always evolving, learning from each other and seeking to improve.

SECONDARY DIVISION

The Middle and Upper Grades are where our ambitious goals for Avenues graduates, defined in our mission statement , are most comprehensively realized. While in grades 6-12, we prepare students for a globally connected, innovation-driven, and largely unknown future. Our students will be: accomplished in all the academic skills you would expect, at ease beyond their borders, and confident because they excel in a particular passion.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

At Avenues, English project teachers work closely with colleagues to design and enact interdisciplinary learning experiences as part of a teaching team within a grade level.

● Ensure that students achieve key learning outcomes, targeting instruction to address individual needs

● Build a learning atmosphere that leads students to feel part of a rigorous and joyful learning community

● Collaborate intensively with colleagues to design interdisciplinary projects and continually deepen student learning

● Inspire trust and confidence among parents and families

Qualifications

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

English teachers at Avenues bring all or most of the following:

● A burning desire to work as part of a project-based, interdisciplinary team

● A remarkable entrepreneurial drive, creativity and ability to bring new ideas to fruition

● Intellectual curiosity and humility, to reflect on and continually grow in teaching practice

● Strong content knowledge in reading, writing and literature, as well as one or more specialized topics (e.g. creative writing, rhetoric, theatre, film, journalism, philosophy, etc.)

● Pedagogy that engages all students in interesting, meaningful and challenging work

● Experience teaching English, with clear evidence of student learning and growth

● A strong sense of personal responsibility for the success of every student

Additional Information

Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.

Avenues upholds the highest standards for safeguarding the physical and emotional wellbeing of children. As an essential aspect of this commitment, all offers are contingent upon successful completion of careful reference and background checks.

title: Cientista de dados
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços TI do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira! Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.

Procuramos Cientista de Dados que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.

Principais Responsabilidades:

Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento (P&D): Conduzir análises exploratórias complexas e desenvolver modelos preditivos e prescritivos para resolver desafios de negócio, desde a otimização de processos até a criação de novos produtos.

Governança de IA e MLOps: Definir, implantar e operacionalizar a governança para todo o ciclo de vida de projetos de Ciência de Dados em ambiente cloud, incluindo a implementação de esteiras de MLOps para automação, monitoramento e versionamento de modelos.

Liderança Técnica e Mentoria: Atuar como referência técnica para a equipe, fornecendo suporte a outros cientistas e engenheiros de dados, disseminando conhecimento e garantindo a aplicação das melhores práticas e padrões de desenvolvimento.

Arquitetura de Soluções de Dados: Projetar e documentar a arquitetura de soluções de IA configurando ambientes e ferramentas em cloud (preferencialmente Azure) e produzindo templates e aceleradores para otimizar a entrega de projetos.

Colaboração com Stakeholders: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as áreas de negócio para entender suas necessidades, traduzir requisitos em especificações técnicas e apresentar os resultados e o valor gerado pelas soluções de forma clara e executiva.

Inovação Contínua: Avaliar e testar novas tecnologias, frameworks e tendências do mercado de IA (ex: Deep Learning, Processamento de Linguagem Natural, Análise de dados de IoT) para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e inovação.

Competências Técnicas :

title: Automation Anywhere Senior RPA Developer
description:
Practia is present in 7 countries, leading automation and digital transformation projects for major clients. We are one of the most prestigious business and technology companies in Latin America, with a specialized methodology and technical team in automation and Hyperautomation.

  • Other certifications and trainings in the intelligent automation field.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

title: Sr. Data Engineer
description:

Do you want to join a team passionate about engineering data solutions to inform business decisions and transform business performance? The Sr. Data Engineer is responsible for delivery, adherence to standards, and mentoring team members. The Sr. Data Engineer collaborates with teams to ensure delivery and contributes to technical design and process improvements. The Sr. Data Engineer is a team player who sees problems as challenges to be creatively solved in collaboration with other data engineers, data scientists, and business colleagues. The ideal candidate is a driven learner who develops and sharpens skills building data pipelines, transforming raw data into useful data systems, and optimizing the data delivery architecture.

  3. Responsible to design, and integrate fault tolerance and enhancements into data pipelines to improve quality and performance

  • Advanced experience with data warehousing concepts and agile methodology

  • Continuous learning to upskill data engineering techniques and business acumen

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, information technology or equivalent combination of data engineering professional experience and education.
